title: Debiasing Online Preference Learning via Preference Feature Preservation
authors_zh: Dongyoung Kim, Jinsung Yoon, Jinwoo Shin, Jaehyung Kim（KAIST、Google Cloud AI Research、延世大学）
paper_type_zh: 在线偏好数据构造与分布保持优化研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建迭代偏好学习流程，并需要避免自生成反馈累积后特征坍缩的读者。
one_line: PFP preserves the feature distribution behind preference labels while generating and training on new online preference records.
PFP 在生成并训练新的在线偏好记录时保留偏好标签背后的特征分布，减少迭代中的特征坍缩。
why: It turns the feature mix behind binary preferences into a constraint on what data is generated and consumed in each online-training round.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly controls how newly generated preference records are conditioned, labeled, ordered, and added during online preference training to preserve a target distribution of preference features.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Online preference learning repeatedly samples responses, labels a new chosen-rejected batch, and trains the next policy. Binary labels compress the reasons for a preference, so an iterative process can overproduce the dominant style, tone, safety, background-knowledge, or informativeness feature that its judge favors. This feedback loop reduces diversity and can degrade alignment dimensions that were initially present in the seed data.

PFP asks how new online preference records can be generated and consumed without drifting away from the original distribution of preference features. It treats those latent reasons as data-governance signals that should shape prompts, response generation, and later optimization. The contribution is an intervention in the online data cycle, not a new static preference dataset.

在线偏好学习会反复采样回答、给新的优劣回答批次标注，并训练下一轮策略。二元标签压缩了偏好产生的原因，因此迭代过程可能过度生成评判器偏好的主导特征，例如文风、语气、安全性、背景知识或信息深度。这种反馈循环会减少多样性，也可能损害种子数据原本包含的其他对齐维度。

PFP 询问如何生成和消费新的在线偏好记录，而不偏离初始偏好特征分布。它把这些潜在原因视为应当塑造提示、回答生成和后续优化的数据治理信号。贡献发生在在线数据循环中的干预，而不是新的静态偏好数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
PFP first asks an LLM to infer five categories of preference features from each offline chosen-rejected example: style, tone, harmlessness, background knowledge, and informativeness. It trains classifiers that map a new instruction to feature distributions, then adjusts these assignments so the new online batch follows the seed distribution rather than the current policy's increasingly biased distribution.

The assigned features are turned into conditioning prefixes. Two prefixes generate two responses; the resulting pair is judged and added to the next preference-training batch. Sampling temperature for these prefixes decreases over iterations to make pairs progressively harder. The central idea is that feature preservation is enforced before labels are consumed, so online preference learning sees a controlled mixture of reasons for preference rather than only whichever reason has become easiest to reward.

PFP 首先让大模型从每个离线优劣回答示例中推断五类偏好特征：文风、语气、无害性、背景知识和信息深度。它训练分类器把新指令映射到特征分布，再调整这些分配，使新的在线批次遵循种子分布，而不是遵循当前策略日益偏置的分布。

这些分配的特征会转化为系统提示。两个提示生成两份回答；所得回答对被判断并加入下一轮偏好训练批次。提示采样温度会随迭代降低，从而使回答对逐步变难。核心思想是在标签被消费前就施加特征保持，因此在线偏好学习看到的是受控的偏好原因混合，而不只是已经最容易获得奖励的原因。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method extracts feature labels from an offline seed dataset with an LLM feature extractor, then trains five feature classifiers. For an online instruction, the classifiers propose features and a distribution-preserving adjustment aligns their aggregate distribution with the initial one. A system-prompt synthesizer turns two sampled feature sets into prompts, the previous policy generates one response under each prompt, and SPA or a reward model selects the preferred response to form a labeled record.

Experiments start with 10,000 UltraFeedback seed examples and use four disjoint online batches of 5,000 prompts. Mistral-7B-v0.1 is initialized from an UltraChat SFT model, while PFP is compared with DPO, iterative DPO, and SPA on AlpacaEval 2.0, MT-Bench, and Anthropic-HHH. Reproduction requires the feature ontology, extractor and classifier versions, distribution target, prompt-synthesis template, temperature schedule, judge, batch order, and model checkpoints.

方法先用大模型特征提取器从离线种子数据集中提取特征标签，再训练五个特征分类器。对于在线指令，分类器提出特征，分布保持调整使其汇总分布与初始分布一致。系统提示合成器把两组抽样特征变成提示，上一轮策略在每个提示下各生成一个回答，SPA 或奖励模型选择优选回答，从而形成带标签记录。

实验从一万个 UltraFeedback 种子示例开始，使用四个互不重叠、每个五千提示的在线批次。Mistral-7B-v0.1 从 UltraChat SFT 模型初始化；PFP 在 AlpacaEval 2.0、MT-Bench 和 Anthropic-HHH 上与 DPO、迭代 DPO 和 SPA 比较。复现需要特征本体、提取器和分类器版本、目标分布、提示合成模板、温度日程、评判器、批次顺序和模型检查点。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that PFP improves AlpacaEval 2.0 length-controlled win rate by 7.66 percentage points over the SFT model and by 2.11 points over iterative DPO. It also reports improvement in harmlessness and honestness across online iterations on Anthropic-HHH, whereas the authors observe feature-distribution drift for the compared online methods. This connects the proposed data-control mechanism to both aggregate preference evaluation and a multi-aspect alignment evaluation.

The evidence also identifies a mechanism boundary: conditioning every response on one fixed prefix reduces response diversity and makes pair judgment harder, so PFP samples two prefixes per instruction. Its curriculum lowers prefix-sampling temperature to make comparisons harder gradually. These findings support the reported Mistral and UltraFeedback pipeline, but feature extraction is itself inferred by an LLM and does not prove that the five chosen feature classes capture all human preference causes.

论文报告，PFP 相对 SFT 模型将 AlpacaEval 2.0 长度控制胜率提高 7.66 个百分点，相对迭代 DPO 提高 2.11 个百分点。它还报告在 Anthropic-HHH 上，随在线迭代无害性和诚实性都有改善，而作者观察到被比较的在线方法存在特征分布漂移。这把所提出的数据控制机制与汇总偏好评测和多维对齐评测联系起来。

证据还指出了一个机制边界：让每份回答都以同一个固定系统提示为条件会降低回答多样性，使回答对判断更困难，因此 PFP 为每个指令采样两个提示。其课程通过降低提示采样温度逐步增加比较难度。这些发现支持所报告的 Mistral 与 UltraFeedback 流程，但特征提取本身由大模型推断，不能证明五类选定特征涵盖全部人类偏好原因。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing online preference methods generally generate new responses under a fixed prompt, label the pair, and optimize on it; distribution drift is an outcome rather than an explicit data-control variable. PFP changes that process by attaching inferred preference features to each seed record, mapping new instructions to feature targets, and constructing the online pair under synthesized prompts that preserve the target feature mix.

The contribution is not simply using conditioning prefixes or curriculum learning. Its reusable novelty is to make a distribution over reasons for preference constrain the generation and consumption of online data. Before reuse, verify feature-extraction agreement, inspect whether feature matching conflicts with a new safety policy, and test whether the preserved distribution represents users rather than an artifact of the seed annotators or the extractor model.

既有在线偏好方法通常在固定提示下生成新回答、标注回答对并据此优化；分布漂移是一个结果，而非显式的数据控制变量。PFP 通过为每条种子记录附加推断出的偏好特征、把新指令映射到特征目标，并在保持目标特征混合的合成提示下构造在线回答对，改变了这一过程。

贡献不只是使用系统提示或课程学习。它可复用的新意是让“偏好原因”的分布约束在线数据的生成和消费。复用前，应核实特征提取的一致性，检查特征匹配是否与新的安全策略冲突，并测试所保持的分布是否代表用户，而非种子标注者或提取器模型的伪影。

title: Limitations
局限
html: PFP relies on an LLM to infer why a binary label was assigned, and on a fixed five-dimensional ontology that may omit culturally specific, task-specific, or conflicting preferences. System-prompt conditioning can reduce the response diversity needed to form useful pairs, while external feature extraction and prompt synthesis add cost and reproducibility dependencies. The target distribution comes from the seed preference data, so preserving it can also preserve the seed's biases. A deployment should audit feature assignments, monitor feature coverage by subgroup, and permit principled changes when the intended preference policy evolves.
PFP 依赖大模型推断二元标签为何被给出，并依赖固定的五维本体；该本体可能遗漏文化特定、任务特定或相互冲突的偏好。系统提示条件化会降低形成有用回答对所需的回答多样性，外部特征提取和提示合成也增加成本与可复现性依赖。目标分布来自种子偏好数据，因此保持它也可能保持种子偏差。部署时应审计特征分配、按子群监测特征覆盖，并在预期偏好策略演化时允许有原则地改变目标。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use PFP when an iterative preference pipeline visibly collapses toward one favored response style or loses alignment dimensions across rounds. Preserve the seed feature distribution, per-instruction feature assignment, conditioning prefixes, pair generator, labels, temperature, and iteration, since these fields explain why a new record entered the training set. It is not appropriate when a fixed seed distribution is known to be obsolete; in that case the distribution itself needs governance rather than automatic preservation.
当迭代偏好流程明显坍缩到一种被偏爱的回答风格，或在多轮中丢失对齐维度时，可使用 PFP。应保留种子特征分布、每个指令的特征分配、系统提示、回答对生成器、标签、温度和迭代轮次，因为这些字段解释了为何新记录进入训练集。当固定种子分布已知过时时，该方法并不合适；此时需要治理分布本身，而不是自动保持它。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The central note is that online preference data can collapse not only by response quality but by the hidden reasons its labels reward. PFP makes those reasons explicit, preserves their aggregate distribution, and turns them into conditions for pair generation. Its gain is meaningful for online alignment, but the strongest audit question is whether the feature ontology and initial distribution are valid policy targets for the deployment context.
核心笔记是，在线偏好数据不仅会在回答质量上坍缩，也会在其标签奖励的隐藏原因上坍缩。PFP 让这些原因显式化，保持它们的汇总分布，并把它们转为回答对生成条件。它对在线对齐的收益有意义，但最重要的审计问题是：特征本体和初始分布是否是部署环境下有效的策略目标。
